data.name: WattWorks
data.detailed_description:
You start with almost nothing and grow into the largest electricity company in the industry.

WattWorks is a chill idle game. Where you build your company and expand with strategy.
You start by build up new and more generators to expand your company. The more power you generate the more your company can expand.

Every tile and structure comes with advantages and trade offs. Smart planning and smart layout will be key to accelerate the growth of your company.

You have the ability to sign contracts with companies that boosts your profits and accelerate your company growth. But sometimes your reach a certain point where the growth stagnates. Then the option to sell your company is a good option as it increases your reputation and enables you to rebuild faster and larger for each time you sell.

data.short_description: WattWorks a chill Idle game where can build and expand your power grid. You play as the manager controlling your company by building power generators and expanding your company in your small world. To Expand further you have to sell your company and rebuild a stronger company
